verdict.rationale: The evidence never documents a pairing step or explicit host approval that a new device must pass before it can view or control the screen. The closest items are adjacent rather than this capability: per-app permissions for guests who are already connected (parsec-docs-13), account MFA (parsec-docs-14), link-based sharing (parsec-docs-11) and invite-based guest access (parsec-docs-27).

support.subject: As a power user, a new device must be paired or explicitly approved before it can see or control the screen
